# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional code changes were required in this Apply Fixes pass. The latest review approved the implementation and follow-up amendments from this cycle with no blocking fixes requested.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the latest approved review results to confirm whether any blocking amendments were requested for the implemented fixes.
2. [Skipped] Apply additional code changes for review follow-up items.
3. [Completed] Record the approved validation state from the latest package test, clippy, and formatting runs.

## Validation Evidence

- Latest review outcome was `approved` with no blocking amendments required.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full package test suite with zero failures.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core` produced zero warnings.
- Formatting check was clean in the latest review validation.
- Review also confirmed the targeted substrate/root-zone oxygenation, denitrification, reproduction-factor, and molt-mineral regression coverage passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation remains scoped to the `tank_core` package rather than a full workspace-wide test run in this stage.
- Two non-blocking cleanup items remain from review: initialization-time `from_parts` still discards the returned `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown`, and `root_oxygenation_active_biomass_g()` still recomputes the habitat registry internally.
